scope: Formatting-only candidate requirements for 1858-1859 packets 51-60. No converter, export, accepted evidence, ledger or source mutation.
method: Read complete preserved source bodies and relevant apparatus layers through the packet/review records; selected feature-bearing body or metadata passages, exact source paths and SHA-256 pins. Special markup and visual requirements are marked planned repair or hold; raw preservation is not treated as clean export readiness.
